name: Alessia Mancini
bio:
Alessia Mancini's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood, spent watching F1 races with her grandfather. This early exposure fueled her pursuit of a mechanical engineering degree, graduating top of her class at the Politecnico di Milano. After university, she quickly ascended through the ranks of junior racing series, proving herself a highly capable engineer. Her strategic thinking and ability to quickly diagnose issues under pressure made her a valuable asset to any team. 

Alessia joined Haas F1 Team three years ago, bringing with her a fresh perspective and an analytical mind. She's known for her meticulous approach to data analysis, identifying subtle performance gains that others might miss. While she is a strong advocate for innovative solutions, she also understands the importance of reliability and consistency in a high-stakes environment. Her visionary outlook pushes the team to continually seek improvement, making her a distinctive presence in the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Alessia has a focused gaze and a slender build, always appearing calm under pressure.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a double espresso before every qualifying session.
